decisions.reason: As a fashion-sensitive decorative fabric with no visible follow-on presence after launch, it likely delivered limited lasting demand and our strong knowledge of adjacent textiles lets us reallocate resources to more learnable and scalable lines.

This transparent burnout decorative fabric is very close to other launched decorative variants, and the lack of continued website evidence suggests overlap rather than a distinct, commercially strong line.

Because it is another burnout decorative fabric with no later market signal, we would treat the early results as insufficient to justify keeping a highly substitutable design-led variant in the assortment.

A velour-like upholstery fabric fits our core upholstery competence and service model well, so our existing knowledge base should let us refine and commercialize it even if later website reporting was limited.
The flame-retardant inbetween fabric extends an established product family with a useful functional attribute, and its close fit to our textile know-how supports continued learning and application.
A polyester lining fabric with satin sheen complements our made-to-measure and stocked-textile business, and its strong relatedness to what we already do makes it a sensible product to retain.
